column3: 简要说明

column2: **When to Memorize and When to Stop: Gated Recurrent Memory for Long-Context Reasoning**
column3: 又称 **GRU-Mem**；在 MemAgent 式 recurrent memory 中加入 update gate 和 exit gate，控制何时写记忆、何时停止。

column2: **Darwinian Memory: A Training-Free Self-Regulating Memory System for GUI Agent Evolution**
column3: GUI agent 记忆系统；把记忆看作可进化生态，通过 utility-driven natural selection 淘汰低价值/高风险 memory。

column2: **Mem-α: Learning Memory Construction via Reinforcement Learning**
column3: 用 RL 训练 agent 学会何时、如何构建和更新 memory。

column2: **OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory**
column3: 把历史轨迹渲染为带视觉锚点的图像，通过 locate-and-transcribe 取回原文，降低 prompt token 成本。

column2: **FSFM: A Biologically-Inspired Framework for Selective Forgetting of Agent Memory**
column3: 选择性遗忘框架；面向效率、质量、安全，删除或衰减冗余、过时、恶意和隐私敏感 memory。

column2: **Belief Memory: Agent Memory Under Partial Observability**
column3: 又称 **BeliefMem**；在部分可观测环境中保存多个候选结论和概率，用 Noisy-OR 更新信念。

column2: **VikingMem: A Memory Base Management System for Stateful LLM-based Applications**
column3: Memory Base 管理系统；事件-实体模型、实体状态更新、时间压缩、多路径检索。

column2: **LEGOMem: Modular Procedural Memory for Multi-agent LLM Systems for Workflow Automation**
column3: 多智能体 workflow procedural memory；把成功轨迹拆成 full-task memory 和 subtask memory。

column2: **Intrinsic Memory Agents: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLM Systems through Structured Contextual Memory**
column3: 每个 agent 维护自身 structured contextual memory，强调 agent 角色异质性。

column2: **SEDM: Scalable Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents**
column3: 分布式自进化 memory；包括 verifiable write admission、self-scheduling controller、cross-domain knowledge diffusion。
column5: 论文称后续发布；当前未确认公开代码库

column2: **RCR-Router: Efficient Role-Aware Context Routing for Multi-Agent LLM Systems with Structured Memory**
column3: 多智能体 role-aware context/memory routing；按 agent role、task stage、token budget 选择 memory 子集。
column5: 论文称接受后发布；当前未确认公开代码库

column2: **Collaborative Memory: Multi-User Memory Sharing in LLM Agents with Dynamic Access Control**
column3: 多用户、多 agent 共享记忆；private/shared memory + provenance + 动态权限控制。

column2: **LLM-Powered Decentralized Generative Agents with Adaptive Hierarchical Knowledge Graph for Cooperative Planning**
column3: 又称 **DAMCS**；去中心化多智能体记忆，用 hierarchical KG 和结构化通信支持开放世界合作规划。

column2: **Multiple Memory Systems for Enhancing the Long-term Memory of Agent**
column3: 认知心理学启发的多记忆系统，把短期 memory 转成 retrieval memory unit 和 contextual memory unit。

column2: **How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior**
column3: 研究 addition/deletion 如何影响 agent，提出 experience-following、error propagation、misaligned replay。
column5: 论文称释放代码；未在本轮确认具体仓库

column2: **D-MEM: Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory via Reward Prediction Error Routing**
column3: 用 reward prediction error 路由 fast/slow memory；高 surprise/high utility 才触发慢速图记忆演化。

column2: **H-Mem: A Novel Memory Mechanism for Evolving and Retrieving Agent Memory via a Hybrid Structure**
column3: 混合 tree + knowledge graph memory，建模长期记忆演化并支持树图联合检索。

column2: **eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents**
column3: 面向 embodied agents 的时空图 memory；SQL + hnswlib + R-tree，多索引联合检索。
column5: 论文称释放系统与 benchmark 代码；未确认具体仓库

column2: **Beyond Similarity: Trustworthy Memory Search for Personal AI Agents**
column3: 提出 **MemGate**；把 memory search 视为 trust boundary，用轻量 gate 过滤语义相似但不合适/有风险的 memory。

column2: **What Happens Inside Agent Memory? Circuit Analysis from Emergence to Diagnosis**
column3: 不是新 memory 架构，而是分析 mem0/A-MEM 内部写入、管理、读取阶段的失败模式。
